faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Threaded Blind Stud (Interior) suitable for Chamber interior threaded blind mounting stud?
faq.a: Titanium Threaded Blind Stud (Interior) uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address chamber hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Threaded Blind Stud (Interior)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Threaded Blind Stud (Interior) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for chamber interior threaded requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Threaded Blind Stud (Interior) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. chamber interior threaded components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for chamber interior threaded application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Threaded Blind Stud (Interior) shipments?

FAIR available on request.
